g.text: FIGURE 6: CAUCHY-EULER, LEGENDRE & SYSTEMS OF DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS ENGINE
Equidimensional Operator Reduction, θ = d/dz Transformation & Coupled Linear First-Order Systems
a₀ xⁿ (dⁿy/dxⁿ) + a₁ xⁿ⁻¹ (dⁿ⁻¹y/dxⁿ⁻¹) + ... + aₙ y = X(x)
Signature feature: Power of x in the coefficient matches the order of the derivative!
Standard linear constant coefficient methods CANNOT be directly applied due to variable x terms.
CANONICAL TRANSFORMATION: x = e^z ⟺ z = ln x
Define operator θ = d/dz. Applying the chain rule yields:
RESULT: CONSTANT COEFFICIENT LINEAR ODE IN z
Solves via standard CF + PI in terms of z, then substitute z = ln x back into the solution!
Roots m ⟹ e^(mz) = (e^z)ᵐ = xᵐ | z e^(mz) = xᵐ ln x
a₀ (ax + b)ⁿ y⁽ⁿ⁾ + a₁ (ax + b)ⁿ⁻¹ y⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾ + ... + aₙ y = X(x)
Generalization of Cauchy-Euler where the base is a linear binomial (ax + b).
Transformation: Put ax + b = e^z ⟺ z = ln(ax + b).
OPERATOR REPLACEMENT (WITH CHAIN RULE FACTOR a)
Define θ = d/dz. Due to d(ax + b)/dx = a, each derivative picks up a factor of a:
⚠️ TOP TRAP: Forgetting the factor aⁿ! (If 2x + 1 appears, a = 2, so a² = 4 multiplies θ(θ-1)).
Two dependent variables x(t) and y(t) with independent parameter t:
dx/dt = a₁₁ x + a₁₂ y + f₁(t)
dy/dt = a₂₁ x + a₂₂ y + f₂(t)
X'(t) = A X(t) where A = [ a₁₁ a₁₂ ; a₂₁ a₂₂ ]
Eigenvalues λ of system matrix A govern system dynamics (Nodes, Saddles, Spirals, Centers)!
Rewrite in differential operator D = d/dt form:
⟹ [ D² - Tr(A) D + Det(A) ] x = F(t) (Standard 2nd-order ODE!)
4. BENCHMARK CAUCHY-EULER DRILL: x² y'' - 3x y' + 4y = x² ln x (HIGH-YIELD GATE PATTERN)
Put x = e^z ⟺ z = ln x, θ = d/dz
Shift e^(2z) out, replace θ with (θ + 2):
Evaluate [1/θ²] z (Integrate z twice w.r.t. z):
• First integral: (1/θ) z = ∫ z dz = z² / 2
Remarkable Elegance: No complex integration needed!
Substitute e^(2z) = x² and z = ln x:
y = x² [ c₁ + c₂ ln x + 1/6 (ln x)³ ]
Whenever repeated roots occur in Cauchy-Euler, the additional independent solutions pick up factors of (ln x), NEVER x!
Standard ODE: (c₁ + c₂ x) e^(mx) ⟷ Cauchy-Euler: (c₁ + c₂ ln x) xᵐ
DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS MATHEMATICAL BLUEPRINT // SCALE: 1.0 NATIVE // GATE / ESE / ISRO EXCELLENCE SUITE
